page.layout: One printed page (left, p. 510) of a dictionary, single column of Greek-headed entries with Latin glosses, running head "Γ" centred at top; to the right a page edge with a fragmentary right-hand printed page carrying cramped marginal/side text (not transcribed as main text, described in notes).

main_text.p: Γαδαρηνὸς ὁ nomen gentile, Hebr. septo cinctus.
Γάζα της ἡ Gaza nomen urbis, Actor.8.26. thesaurus.
Γάϊος ὁ Cajus nomen viri, Latinis olim idem erat quod nunc dominus.
Γαλακτία ας ἡ nomen regionis, Gr.Lactea.
Γαλιλαία ας ἡ nomen reg. Hebr.limes.
Γαλλίων ωνος ὁ nomen viri Gr. videtur sic dictus a lacteo colore.
Γαμαλιὴλ ὁ nomen viri ἀχλιτον, Hebr. retributio Dei.
Γεδὼν ὁ nomen herois ἀχλιτον, Hebr. evulsor.
Γεδονημένη ης ἡ nomen reg. Hebr. vallis pinguedinis.
Γεννησαρὲτ ἡ nomen reg. ἀχλιτον, Hebr. hortus principis.
Γεργεσηνὸς ὁ nomen gentile, Hebr. vicinus peregrinationi.
Γολγοθᾶ nomen loci ἀχλίῳ, Syr. locus calvariae.
Γόμορρα ας ἡ nomen urbis, Syr. habitatio.
Γὼγ ὁ nomen gentis. Vulgo tectum interpretantur, quod Hebraice dicitur.

page.notes: Greek headwords and Hebrew glosses are transcribed approximately; several Greek and Hebrew forms are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The right-hand fragment (side text of another page, cramped and partly cut) was not transcribed as it is not legible enough. Catchword "Δα-" at foot right is uncertain.
